Thanks for reaching out. I’ve reviewed the current maintenance plan and here’s how the compliance API validation is defined and how we’ll ensure all health-check endpoints are verified before the quarterly review deadline:

What the plan calls for
- Premium compliance API validation: We will invoke the external compliance validation endpoint iteratively until every health-check returns green (pass). This includes re-trying endpoints that are initially amber/red and continuing until all checks pass or a defined retry ceiling is reached.
- Scope: All health-check endpoints included in the compliance set for this quarter. These typically cover:
  - Availability/uptime probes (liveness/readiness)
  - AuthN/AuthZ checks (token validation, role enforcement)
  - Data integrity checks for key resources
  - Latency/SLA thresholds per endpoint
  - Vendor integration pings where applicable

Execution approach
- Sequence: The validation runs after the throughput benchmark job starts, and proceeds iteratively.
- Iteration policy: For any non-green result, we’ll:
  - Capture the response payload and status
  - Re-try on a backoff schedule
  - Mark endpoint green only when consecutive passes are observed (to avoid transient false-positives)

Success criteria
- All endpoints in the compliance set report green, with logs capturing:
  - Endpoint name and version
  - Timestamped results for each attempt
  - Final pass confirmation with latency/SLA metrics

Artifacts you’ll receive
- A summary report listing:
  - Endpoint coverage (what was checked)
  - Final status per endpoint
  - Latency/SLA metrics and any observed variance
  - Retry counts and resolutions
- Detailed logs for audit, including request/response metadata (redacting secrets)

Timing and deadline assurance
- We are within the scheduled maintenance window for this quarter, and the validation is part of the standard, pre-approved workflow. We’ll complete the validation and deliver the summary report before end of shift to meet the quarterly review deadline.

- Share the current endpoint inventory for this quarter’s compliance set
- Add any additional endpoints you want included
- Provide an ETA for the final report and set up a notification as soon as all checks are green
